scope: Merchant cancellation notifications and event-driven card reconciliation
backend: Committed exceptionCancellation changes forwarded through existing DynamoDB stream without creating a new mapping
Recipient resolved from a strongly consistent canonical order; no client-selected branch
FCM notification includes stable eventId and current case reference; stale requested references resolve to current final state
Branch-device filter preserved and missing branch-device-push dependency supplied in notification packages
Merchant order list hydrates cancellation metadata and timestamps with consistent base-table reads
application: Branch-scoped cancellation event refreshes order card and displays pending-review banner
Repeated event ID is ignored; cancellation does not trigger a new-order sound
Periodic order-data fetching removed from attention host, owner/employee order lists and realtime fallback; transport heartbeat and local reminder timers remain
One-time reconciliation on initial load, resume, reconnect and push/socket events; manual refresh retained
Cache detects cancellation changes even when order status/timestamp unchanged
limitations: Real foreground/background push receipt and latency require a new genuine test order; provider ACK alone is not device-receipt proof.
